the guard only skips a classification loop that is a no-op for the token lists it skips. Those fast paths differ from `processTokens` in exactly one place — `processSimpleParams` drops an accumulated empty prefix before a node part — which a TEXT-first template can never reach, since its leading text token is non-empty by construction (the parser never emits an empty TK_TEXT).
